description: Use when access must reach past the record owner's role hierarchy. Trigger keywords: sharing rule, criteria-based sharing rule, owner-based sharing rule, sharing rule recalculation, guest user sharing rule, share with a public group, SharingRules metadata. NOT for org-wide defaults - use admin/sharing-and-visibility. NOT for programmatic shares - use apex/apex-managed-sharing. NOT for subtracting access - use admin/restriction-rules.
inputs: Object in scope and its org-wide default — a sharing rule is meaningless on an object whose OWD is already Public Read/Write
Who needs the access, expressed as a group Salesforce can name: public group, role, role and internal subordinates, queue, territory, or guest user
What determines the access — who owns the record (owner-based) or what is on the record (criteria-based)
Access level required: Read Only or Read/Write, plus per-child access if the object is Account
Record and user volume on the object, because that is what turns recalculation from seconds into hours
name: sharing-rules
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide — **SharingRules** (container; `sharingCriteriaRules` / `sharingOwnerRules` / `sharingTerritoryRules` at API 33.0+, `sharingGuestRules` at API 47.0+; `includeRecordsOwnedByAll` and `includeHVUOwnedRecords` both "you can't edit this field after the sharing rule is created"; "For SharingGuestRule, the accessLevel field can be set only to Read") — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_sharingrules.htm (verified 2026-08-15)

Metadata API Developer Guide — **SharingBaseRule** (`accessLevel`, `sharedTo`, `label` required; `description` max 1,000 characters; `AccountSharingRuleSettings` with `caseAccessLevel` / `contactAccessLevel` / `opportunityAccessLevel` each required and each `None`, `Read`, or `Edit`; API 33.0+, replaces the deprecated `BaseSharingRule`) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_sharingbaserule.htm (verified 2026-08-15)

Metadata API Developer Guide — **SharedTo** (recipient elements including `group`, `role`, `roleAndSubordinatesInternal`, `queue` — "Applies only to lead, case, and CustomObject" — `territory`, `managers`, `managerSubordinates`, `allInternalUsers` — "A group containing all internal and nonportal users") — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_sharedto.htm (verified 2026-08-15)

Metadata API Developer Guide — **CriteriaBasedSharingRule** (removed at API 33.0; retained here only for the `accessLevel` enumeration "The possible values are: Read, Edit, All" and the `criteriaItems` shape `field, operation, value`) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_cbsrule.htm (verified 2026-08-15)

Metadata API Developer Guide — **ListView** (the shared `FilterOperation` enumeration used by `criteriaItems/operation`: `equals`, `notEqual`, `lessThan`, `greaterThan`, `lessOrEqual`, `greaterOrEqual`, `contains`, `notContain`, `startsWith`, `includes`, `excludes`, and `within` for DISTANCE criteria only) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_listview.htm (verified 2026-08-15)

Metadata API Developer Guide — **Sharing Rules package.xml sample** (the verbatim manifest reproduced in SKILL.md, showing `SharingCriteriaRule` with an `Object.RuleName` member, `SharingOwnerRule` with `*`, and `SharingTerritoryRule` with `Account.*` at version 33.0) — local copy `knowledge/imports/salesforce-metadata-api-guide.md`

Apex Developer Guide — **Creating Apex Managed Sharing** (share object naming for standard vs custom objects; the four share fields, named `AccessLevel` on a custom object's share and `<Object>AccessLevel` on a standard one; `ParentId` and `RowCause` "can't be updated"; "The All access level is an internal value and can't be granted"; "The reason determines the type of sharing, which controls who can alter the sharing record"; manual shares "removed when ownership changes" versus Apex managed shares "maintained when the record owner changes or is deactivated") — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_bulk_sharing_creating_with_apex.htm (verified 2026-08-15)

Apex Developer Guide — **Understanding Sharing** (access levels Private/Read/Edit/All, with `All` — Full Access — documented as a level that "can only be granted with managed sharing"; the `RowCause` set `Owner`, `Manual`, `Rule`, `Team`, `ImplicitChild`, `ImplicitParent`, `TerritoryRule`, `TerritoryManual`, `Territory2AssociationManual`) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_bulk_sharing_understanding.htm (verified 2026-08-15)

Salesforce Architects — **Record-Level Access: Under the Hood**, Spring '26 (access grants only under Private / Public Read Only OWD; precomputation rather than run-time evaluation; the `Manual` and `Rule` row causes; deletion of `Manual` shares on ownership change; role-change case study showing sharing-rule recalculation; "the size and complexity of an organization's queues and hierarchies directly affect the duration of record access calculations") — https://architect.salesforce.com/fundamentals/record-level-access-under-hood, local copy `knowledge/imports/salesforce-record-access-under-the-hood.md`

Salesforce **Large Data Volumes Best Practices** — Defer Sharing Calculation (the permission suspends and resumes two processes, group membership calculation and sharing rule calculation; the documented load order of users into roles, then record data with owners, then public groups and queues, then sharing rules one at a time) — local copy `knowledge/imports/salesforce-large-data-volumes-best-practices.md`

Salesforce **Security Guide**, v262 PDF (the per-object cap "You can define up to 300 total sharing rules for each object, including up to 50 criteria-based or guest user sharing rules, if available for the object"; "Guest user sharing rules can only grant Read Only access"; recalculation monitoring on the Background Jobs page and the Setup Audit Trail, plus the completion email; the share locks that block org-wide default and sharing-rule edits during recalculation; "If sharing rules are recalculated for accounts, cases, contacts, or opportunities, sharing rules are also recalculated for the other three objects"; "After this work is completed, you must resume sharing rule calculations and manually initiate a full sharing rule recalculation to prevent errors"; "The Recalculate button is disabled when group membership or sharing rule calculations are deferred"; the pre-Spring '22 remedy for `includeRecordsOwnedByAll`, "delete the rule and select Include records owned by users who can't have an assigned role when you recreate it") — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_security_impl_guide.pdf (verified 2026-08-15)
outputs: A rule design naming rule type, source group, target group, access level, and the exact criteria fields
Deployable `<Object>.sharingRules-meta.xml` and the matching package.xml manifest entries
Verification SOQL against the object's `__Share` table filtered to `RowCause = 'Rule'`
A recalculation plan for structural changes, including when to use deferred sharing maintenance
Checker-script output listing malformed, over-broad, or non-deployable rules
